observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a black game console with angled vent pattern on lower half, consistent with an original Xbox One body shape.
Xbox logo visible on the front left edge in photo 1.
Visible scuffs, scratches, and a dark smudge/stain on the top panel in photo 1.
Photo 2 shows the rear of the console with a white specification label reading 'XBOX ONE CONSOLE' and a partially legible model line, HDMI port visible above label.
No power supply brick, power cable, or controller visible in any photo.
No photo shows the console powered on, a home screen, or games list.

claims.claim: Fairly used Xbox One in very good condition
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows visible scratches and a dark stain/smudge on the top casing, inconsistent with 'very good condition'.
No photo of a powered-on screen, dashboard, or game library is shown.
No controller or power cable/brick appears in any of the 3 photos, matching the seller's own disclosure that these are missing.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or boot at all (internal fault, disc drive issue, overheating history)
risks.proof: A video clip of the console powering on to the home dashboard screen

risks.risk: Missing power adapter and controller means buyer cannot even test or use the unit without separately sourcing both, adding real cost
risks.proof: Photo of the included power brick and at least one controller, if seller can supply one
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only, accessories cost added on top for buyer

risks.risk: Hard drive condition and storage capacity unknown, could affect value of the '5 games installed' claim
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full rear label showing model/storage spec, and a dashboard storage screen
risks.if_unproven: priced without extra value for installed games

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage beyond scuffs (e.g. disc tray function, HDMI port condition) cannot be assessed
risks.proof: Close-up photo of disc tray open/closed and HDMI port pins
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming cosmetic wear only, no functional premium

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on to the Xbox dashboard
Photo of the full rear label in focus (model number, storage size)
Confirmation/photo of any accessories actually included (even if used)
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an Xbox One console from the rear label and body shape, but it lacks power supply and controller and has no proof of powering on, so it must be priced at worst case as an untested, accessory-less unit despite being a recognizable, nameable item.
